# Read RSEM data for allele specific expression
```{r}
# Make counts by rsem 
library(tximport)
# Base directory for RSEM outputs
rsem_base_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/rsem_quantification"
sampledata <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/tm3_metadata_with_ibdpainting_all_samples.txt", header=T, sep="\t")
# Construct sample paths 
sample_paths <- file.path(rsem_base_dir)
# Collect gene results 
files <- file.path(sample_paths, paste0(sampledata$Sample_id, ".genes.results"))
# Check which files exist
existing_files <- files[file.exists(files)]
# Get the sample IDs from sampledata that correspond to existing files
file_indices <- which(file.exists(files))
fileSampleIDs <- sampledata$Sample_id[file_indices]
# Create a named vector for tximport with proper sample IDs
names(existing_files) <- fileSampleIDs
# Verify the names are correct
head(names(existing_files))
# Perform tximport for RSEM quantification
txi.rsem <- tximport(existing_files, type = "rsem")

# Check column names now
head(colnames(txi.rsem$counts))
dim(txi.rsem$counts)

# Filter sampledata 
filteredSampleData <- sampledata[sampledata$Sample_id %in% fileSampleIDs, ]
rownames(filteredSampleData) <- filteredSampleData$Sample_id

# Subset txi.rsem
sampleNames <- rownames(filteredSampleData)

# Subset the txi.rsem object
txi.rsem$counts <- txi.rsem$counts[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$abundance <- txi.rsem$abundance[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]
txi.rsem$length <- txi.rsem$length[, sampleNames, drop = FALSE]

# Now extract counts
counts <- txi.rsem$counts
rownames(counts) <-rownames(txi.rsem$counts)
dim(counts)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
colnames(counts) <- (paste(filteredSampleData$Genotype, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Accession, 
                                     filteredSampleData$Replicate,
                                     filteredSampleData$Request_id,filteredSampleData$Sample_id, sep="_"))
# Define variant 
variant <- factor(filteredSampleData$Variant)
genotype <- factor(filteredSampleData$Genotype)
d0 <- DGEList(counts = counts)
d0 <- d0[rowSums(d0$counts) > 0, ]
# Keep genes/TEs with >= 10 counts total across all samples (not restricted to ddm1_ct)
keep <- rowSums(d0$counts) >= -1
d0_filtered <- d0[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
# Normalize
d0_filtered <- calcNormFactors(d0_filtered)

# Print summary
cat("Total genes before filtering:", nrow(d0), "\n")
cat("Genes retained after filtering:", nrow(d0_filtered), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round(nrow(d0_filtered)/nrow(d0)*100, 1), "%\n")

# Before filtering
log_cpm_before <- cpm(d0, log=TRUE)
# After filtering
log_cpm_after_manual <- cpm(d0_filtered, log=FALSE,normalized.lib.sizes=FALSE)
#log_cpm_after_manual <- log2(log_cpm_after_manual+1)
log_cpm_after <- log_cpm_after_manual
# Plot density distributions
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(density(log_cpm_before), main="Before filtering", xlab="log2 counts")
plot(density((log_cpm_after)), main="After filtering", xlab="log2 counts")
```

## PCA of genes and TEs colored based on the allele
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Separate the two allele matrices
tair <- log_cpm_after[grepl("_tair10$", rownames(log_cpm_after)), , drop = FALSE]
acc <- log_cpm_after[grepl("_100752(\\.[0-9]+)?$", rownames(log_cpm_after)), , drop = FALSE]

# Strip suffixes to get matching feature IDs
rownames(tair) <- sub("_tair10$", "", rownames(tair))
rownames(acc) <- sub("_100752(\\.[0-9]+)?$", "", rownames(acc))

# Split feature IDs into Genes vs TEs
gene_ids <- grep("^AT[1-5]G",  intersect(rownames(tair), rownames(acc)), value = TRUE)
te_ids <- grep("^AT[1-5]TE[0-9]+$", intersect(rownames(tair), rownames(acc)), value = TRUE) ## Need to be fixed?


meta_ase <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(tair),
  Genotype = sub("^(F1_[^_]+)_.*$", "\\1", colnames(tair))
)

run_pca <- function(ids, tair, acc, meta_ase, title) {
    x <- t(cbind(tair[ids, ], acc[ids, ]))
    pca_info <- data.frame(
        Allele   = rep(c("TAIR10", "100752"), each = ncol(tair)),
        Genotype = rep(meta_ase$Genotype, times = 2)
    )

    pca <- prcomp(x, scale. = FALSE)
    var_exp <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

    ggplot(
        data.frame(pca$x, pca_info),
        aes(PC1, PC2, color = Allele, shape = Genotype)
    ) +
        geom_point(size = 4) +
        labs(
            title = title,
            x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
            y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 16)
}

p_genes <- run_pca(gene_ids, tair, acc, meta_ase, title = "PCA - Genes")
p_tes   <- run_pca(te_ids, tair, acc, meta_ase, title = "PCA - TEs")

p_genes
p_tes
```

## Upload probabilities defined by RSEM and attach them to the analysis
```{r}
library(data.table)
aln <- fread(
  "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/rsem_quantification/all_alignments_combined.tsv",
  header = FALSE, sep = "\t",
  col.names = c("sample_id", "read_id", "transcript_id", "STAR_NH", "RSEM_ZW"),
  na.strings = "NA"
)[!is.na(RSEM_ZW)]

## Add STAR multimapping/ and probability 
aln[, `:=`(
  sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
  STAR_NH = as.integer(STAR_NH),
  RSEM_ZW = as.numeric(RSEM_ZW)
)]

genes <- aln[grepl("^AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}\\.[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", transcript_id)] # Select only genes
# Select genome id 
genes[, `:=`(
  gene_id = sub("^(AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}).*$", "\\1", transcript_id),
  genome  = sub("^.*_([A-Za-z0-9]+)$", "\\1", transcript_id)
)]

## Select features
features <- aln[grepl("^AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}\\.[0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+$", transcript_id) |
                 grepl("TE[0-9]+", transcript_id)]

features[, `:=`(
  feature_id = ifelse(
    grepl("^AT[1-5]G", transcript_id),
    sub("^(AT[1-5]G[0-9]{5}).*$", "\\1", transcript_id),
    sub("^(.*TE[0-9]+).*$", "\\1", transcript_id)
  ),
  genome = sub("^.*_([A-Za-z0-9]+)$", "\\1", transcript_id),
  feature_type = ifelse(grepl("^AT[1-5]G", transcript_id), "gene", "TE")
)]
features[, genome := sub("^.*_([A-Za-z0-9]+)(\\.[0-9]+)?$", "\\1", transcript_id)] ## Get the genome right 
genes <- features
```

```{r}
## ---------------------------------------------------------
## GOAL: Build a read-level table with:
##   - RSEM weight assigned to tair10
##   - RSEM weight assigned to 100752
##   - STAR NH value for that read
## Now generalized to work for BOTH genes and TEs (feature_id/feature_type)
## ---------------------------------------------------------

## Step 1: For each read + feature + genome, add up the RSEM weight
## (this collapses isoforms, since multiple transcripts of the
## same feature/genome are summed together)
weights_by_read_feature_genome <- features[
  , .(weight = sum(RSEM_ZW)),
  by = .(sample_id, read_id, feature_id, genome, feature_type)
]

## Step 2: Turn the "genome" column into two separate columns
## (one per genome), so each read+feature has its weights side by side
weights_wide <- dcast(
  weights_by_read_feature_genome,
  sample_id + read_id + feature_id + feature_type ~ genome,
  value.var = "weight",
  fill = 0
)

## Step 3: Get the STAR NH value for each read
## Check for malformed records
nh_per_read <- unique(
  features[, .(sample_id, read_id, NH = STAR_NH)]
)
anyDuplicated(nh_per_read, by = c("sample_id", "read_id")) # If 0 - each read has its unique value

## Step 4: Attach the NH value onto our weights table
weights_wide[
  nh_per_read,
  NH := i.NH,
  on = c("sample_id", "read_id")
]

read_feature <- weights_wide

feature_table <- read_feature[
  tair10 + `100752` > 0,
  .(
    supporting_reads = .N,
    NH_median = as.numeric(median(NH, na.rm = TRUE)),
    multimapped_frac = mean(NH > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prob_tair10 = sum(tair10) / (sum(tair10) + sum(`100752`)),
    prob_100752_v2 = sum(`100752`) / (sum(tair10) + sum(`100752`))
  ),
  by = .(sample_id, feature_id, feature_type)
]

feature_table[, prob_100752 := 1 - prob_tair10]

head(feature_table)

## If you want them split back out:
gene_table <- feature_table[feature_type == "gene"]
te_table   <- feature_table[feature_type == "TE"]

ggplot(te_table, aes(prob_100752, prob_100752_v2))+geom_point()
ggplot(gene_table, aes(prob_100752, prob_100752_v2))+geom_point()
```

```{r}
## Weights  
own_annotation_table <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/ase/own_annotaion_te_genes_with_weights.csv")
liftov_annotation_table <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/ase/tair10_liftov_annotaion_te_genes_with_weights.csv")
## Expression 
own_annotation_expression <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/ase/expression_own_annotation.csv")
tair10_annotation_expression <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/ase/expression_liftov_annotation.csv")
```

```{r}
## Make a long format out of the expression
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

tair <- own_annotation_expression[grepl("_tair10$", rownames(own_annotation_expression)), , drop = FALSE]
acc <- own_annotation_expression[grepl("_100752(\\.[0-9]+)?$", rownames(own_annotation_expression)), , drop = FALSE]

# Strip suffixes to get matching feature IDs
rownames(tair) <- sub("_tair10$", "", rownames(tair))
rownames(acc) <- sub("_100752(\\.[0-9]+)?$", "", rownames(acc))

pattern <- "^(F1_(?:Col|ddm1))_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([^_]+)$"
tair_long <- tair %>%
  as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = c(
      "genotype",
      "accession_id",
      "replicate",
      "plate",
      "run_id"
    ),
    names_pattern = pattern,
    values_to = "expression_tair10"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    accession_id = as.integer(accession_id),
    replicate     = as.integer(replicate),
    plate = as.integer(plate),
    run_id        = as.integer(run_id)
  )


acc_long <- acc %>%
  as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ID,
    names_to = c(
      "genotype",
      "accession_id",
      "replicate",
      "plate",
      "run_id"
    ),
    names_pattern = pattern,
    values_to = "expression_acc"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    accession_id = as.integer(accession_id),
    replicate     = as.integer(replicate),
    plate = as.integer(plate),
    run_id        = as.integer(run_id)
  )

own_annotation_expression <- full_join(acc_long,tair_long)
#tair10_annotation_expression <- full_join(acc_long,tair_long)
```

```{r}
## Calculate ASE in each of the expression tables 
own_annotation_expression$ase <- own_annotation_expression$expression_tair10/(own_annotation_expression$expression_acc+own_annotation_expression$expression_tair10)
tair10_annotation_expression$ase <- tair10_annotation_expression$expression_tair10/(tair10_annotation_expression$expression_acc+tair10_annotation_expression$expression_tair10)
```

## Attach to RSEM and Greg's counts 
```{r}

genes_ase <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/epiclines/010.GbM_vs_Expr_in_F1s/03.processing/02.kannomes/004.filtered_ASE_table/forLiza_new/ASE_diploid_counts_filtered.csv.gz", header=T)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Ensure it's a data.table
dt <- as.data.table(liftov_annotation_table_with_expression)

# Confident mapping = highest allele-assignment probability > 80%
dt[, confident_prob := pmax(prob_tair10, prob_100752)]
dt_conf <- dt[confident_prob > 0.8]

# Reshape to long format so both expression_acc (100752) and expression_tair10
# can be plotted side by side per feature
dt_long <- melt(
  dt_conf,
  id.vars = c("sample_id", "feature_id", "feature_type", "genotype",
              "accession_id", "replicate", "plate"),
  measure.vars = c("expression_acc", "expression_tair10"),
  variable.name = "allele_genome",
  value.name = "expression"
)

# Cleaner labels for the allele/genome of origin
dt_long[, allele_genome := factor(allele_genome,
                                   levels = c("expression_acc", "expression_tair10"),
                                   labels = c("100752", "TAIR10"))]

# Boxplot: expression (log10 scale) by feature_type, split by allele/genome,
# faceted by genotype
dt_long_tair10 <- na.omit(dt_long)
dt_long_tair10$annotation <- 'tair10'
ggplot(dt_long, aes(x = feature_type, y = log2(expression+1), fill = allele_genome)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~ genotype) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene and TE expression by genotype (mapping probability > 80%)",
    x = "Feature type",
    y = "Expression (log2)",
    fill = "Heplotype / genome"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) 
```

```{r}
dt_combined <-dt_combined[dt_combined$feature_type=="TE" & dt_combined$genotype=="F1_Col",]
ggplot(dt_combined, aes(x = annotation, y = log2(expression+1), fill = allele_genome)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene and TE expression by annotation source",
    x = "Annotation",
    y = "Expression (log2)",
    fill = "Annotation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
## Get place where TEs are expressed
te_annotation <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/007_allele_specific_expression/test_run_as/100752.TE_merged.renamed.withTEid.forR.gff3", header=F)
te_annotation$class <- sub(".*class=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", te_annotation$V6)
te_annotation$V3<- gsub("_100752", "", te_annotation$V3)

dt_combined_missing_check_class_with_coord <- inner_join(dt_combined_missing_check_class,te_annotation, by=c("feature_id"="V3"))

ggplot(dt_combined_missing_check_class_with_coord, aes(V4, V1, color = log2(expression + 1))) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("Mbp") +
  ylab("chromosome")

ggplot(dt_combined_missing_check_class_with_coord, aes(V4, V1, color = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("Mbp") +
  ylab("chromosome")

## Calculate CNV in the file 
# Count copy number per class
cnv_counts <- te_annotation %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CNV = n())

# Merge with expression data
cnv_expression <- dt_combined_missing_check_class_with_coord %>%
  filter(class %in% te_annotation$class) %>%
  left_join(cnv_counts, by = "class")

# Plot CNV vs expression
ggplot(cnv_expression, aes(x = CNV, y = log2(expression + 1), color = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  xlab("CNV (copy number)") +
  ylab("Expression (log2)")
```
